text:
maya (product): Quick sync — we need to lock the public 429 payload shape so SDKs and the console can ship consistent UX. I put a concrete suggestion in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4012. Looking for :+1: or objections.

sam (devex): +1 to extra structured fields. Can we make `help_url` deterministic per-org so the console button jumps straight to a user's quota page?

liam (eng-platform): We can produce org-scoped help_url when request contains org_id. For per-key tokens we can return a generic help_url and include a `resolve_url_template` like `/orgs/{org_id}/quota`.

oliver (sdk): From SDK POV: keep a short human `message` and a machine `code` (e.g. `RATE_LIMIT`). Expose `retry_after_ms` in the exception object so apps can implement backoff without parsing headers.

anika (docs): I'll prepare examples for both console toasts and SDK exception docs. Need canonical JSON example to copy.

tess (eng-runtime): For burst controls we should include `allowed_burst` and `burst_remaining`. Also prefer `retry_after_ms` (ms precision) instead of seconds.

maya (product): Proposal (canonical payload):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Request rate exceeded for this API key.",
    "quota_category": "per-key",
    "rate_limit_id": "rl:ingest:us-east-1:burst",
    "retry_after_ms": 2500,
    "allowed_burst": 50,
    "burst_remaining": 12,
    "help_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/1234/quota?focus=rate-limit"
  }
}
```

sam (devex): Looks good. Console toast suggestion: "Too many requests — retry in ~2.5s" and an action button "Open quota dashboard" linking to `help_url`. Toast should surface `rate_limit_id` in developer-mode for troubleshooting.

oliver (sdk): SDK will map http 429 -> RateLimitError with fields: `code`, `message`, `retry_after_ms`, `rate_limit_id`, `quota_category`. Also suggest adding `suggested_backoff_ms` for jitter recommendations.

liam (eng-platform): Telemetry plan: tag metrics with `rate_limit_id`, `quota_category`, and `org_id` when present; increment per-tenant counters and emit a sampling of `help_url` for routing analysis.

anika (docs): I'll draft two short copy variants: one for user-facing console copy and one example error shown in SDK docs. Also will add a quick troubleshooting FAQ for "what to do when I hit limits".

deploy-bot: PR 4012 merged to staging/docs at 1783456800.

maya (product): Next steps: owners? need E2E tests, SDK PR, runtime telemetry + runbook update.

oliver (sdk): I'll own the SDK PR and add example bindings for Python/JS.

tess (eng-runtime): I'll add runtime support for the fields + unit tests and the burst counters.

anika (docs): I'll complete docs copy and the console toast screenshots.

liam (eng-platform): I'll coordinate rollout window and ensure feature flag gating for per-org help_url.

maya (product): Great — thanks. If no more blockers I'll merge the platform change after Tess's tests and Oliver's SDK draft.

sam (devex): Tiny UX note: include `human_message` localized string id for console so we can ship translations later.

maya (product): noted, add `human_message_id` to the shape. We'll keep `message` as fallback."
